experiments.name: aa-dense
experiments.decides: Run first. Same binary and settings on both sides, so the true gain is 0. A/A NOISY means the card or the host is not quiet enough for 1% verdicts: find the cause (guard.sh --clients, --temp, a display session on the card) before any other row counts.

experiments.name: onednn-314-sdpa
experiments.decides: oneDNN's xe_hpg SDPA retunes (b3225e00f4, 264fa75ace) first ship in 3.14. The same tree built against oneDNN 3.14 or later (B) against AB_BUILD (A) on C62's head_dim 64 path. Only when guard.sh --stamp shows AB_BUILD loading an older libdnnl, and after C62's test-backend-ops case passes. B puts the newer libdnnl first on LD_LIBRARY_PATH, which oneAPI's setvars.sh would otherwise win over the build's RUNPATH.
